x: EasyIsland is an island always at hand at the top of your Windows screen, with a small animated character. From there you keep an eye on coding agents Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Antigravity, Gemini CLI , answer their permission requests with one click, chat with the AI engine you prefer, make calls with 3CX, run your quick actions and follow your services. Since version 1.0.0 it is also a personal agent : it carries tasks forward on its own, remembers what matters and organises it in a second brain you can explore. ! The island open on the Overview ../media/overview.png Who it is for People who code with an AI agent and don't want to watch the terminal: permissions, questions, file changes and the end of the work reach the island. People who work with clients technicians, consultants, small offices : tickets, the 3CX phone system, Outlook, Teams, remote access, Remote Desktop Manager and Notion in one place. Anyone who wants an AI assistant on their own PC that really uses their tools, with control over every action. WebView2, which draws the interface, is already part of Windows. For the chat with a Claude subscription: Claude Code on the command line , signed in see AI engines 09-engines.md . Everything else is optional: each integration only asks for what it needs. Principles EasyIsland is built on a few rules that hold everywhere: Nothing happens without you. Permissions, emails, deletions, installs: always your click. The only exception is the "Automatic" mode you turn on yourself, and even there deletions still ask. No telemetry. Network requests only go to the services you configure, plus the update check on GitHub, which can be turned off. Secrets kept safe. Keys, tokens and passwords live in the Windows Credential Manager , never on disk or in the interface. Never blocks an agent. If EasyIsland doesn't answer, agents carry on in the terminal as if it weren't there. Light. With the island tucked away nothing is drawn: CPU close to zero. Note: the interface is available in English and Italian Settings → General → Language . EasyIsland is open source under the MIT license, born as a Windows-only version of Coucou. The code is on GitHub https://github.com/EdoardoDevelop/easyisland .

Install Open the releases on GitHub https://github.com/EdoardoDevelop/easyisland/releases/latest and download EasyIsland-Windows-X.Y.Z-setup.exe . Run it. It installs for the current user only : no administrator prompt. The installer is not yet signed with a certificate, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning: click More info → Run anyway . When it's done EasyIsland starts and the character greets you. From then on you'll find it in the Start menu and in the notification area the ^ arrow next to the clock . Tip: if Defender blocks the installer, it's the usual false positive for unsigned programs: use "Run anyway". Where files go What Where --- --- The program %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyIsland The relay for agents %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyIsland\bin\easyisland-hook.exe The log %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyIsland\easyisland.log Settings, memory, tasks, skills, custom integrations %APPDATA%\EasyIsland Keys, tokens, passwords Windows Credential Manager never on disk Update At startup and then once a day EasyIsland checks GitHub for a newer version. If there is one, the island shows an update card with Install and Later : nothing is installed without your click; the update is signed and the signature is verified before running it; while installing, EasyIsland closes and reopens by itself; settings and keys stay. In Settings → General → Updates you see the version, check by hand with Check now or turn the automatic check off. Uninstall First, in Settings → Coding agents , click Uninstall… on the row of each connected agent: on purpose, the Windows uninstaller doesn't touch the agents' configuration files for example Claude Code's settings.json . Then Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps → EasyIsland → Uninstall . The %APPDATA%\EasyIsland folder memory, tasks, skills stays: delete it by hand if you no longer need it. Build it yourself If you prefer to start from the source code you need Git, Node.js, Rust and the Visual Studio Build Tools: the steps are in For developers 28-development.md . The result is the same installer.

Before writing you see: the exact diff of what will change in the agent's configuration file; the path of the dated backup copy that will be created. Nothing is written until you click. Your own hooks are never touched and uninstalling removes only EasyIsland's entries. How it works The agent calls a small program, easyisland-hook.exe , at every event start, tool, permission, end . The relay has 300 ms to reach EasyIsland and exits quietly if the app is closed or slow: a session is never blocked or slowed down . If nobody answers a permission in time, the agent asks in the terminal as usual. In the Agents tab ! Permissions with Deny / Allow / Always . "Always" uses the rule proposed by the agent the card says which or a session-only rule. Later folds the card away with the time left. EasyIsland's memory is made of Markdown files in %APPDATA%\EasyIsland\memoria , which you can read and fix with any editor. It works with every engine . It turns off together with the history Settings → Chat → History . Folder and file names on disk are in Italian memoria , diario , pagine , da-leggere , fonti , archivio . Notes: MEMORIA.md Things to always remember, one per line with the date: preferences, clients, people, how something is done. They go in front of the first question of every conversation 4,000 characters at most, newest first , so they cost few tokens. The chat saves them by itself when you say something that also holds for next time. You save them with /ricorda … in the chat, or from the Remember… field of the Memory window. Past 60 notes the oldest move to archivio.md , which stays searchable. No passwords or keys: the chat is instructed not to save them. The diary diario/YYYY-MM.md : one line per answered question time, engine, question, start of the answer . EasyIsland writes it without any model , so it costs nothing. The chat looks into it only when needed "last time, how did we solve…?" . Linked pages pagine/.md : one page per subject a person, a client, a project, a concept , like a wiki: Title links another page; a line - relation: Other says how they are related. riassunto: summary is one sentence on who or what it is; alias: the other names you call it by acronyms, product names . They are optional: the memory engine or the chat writes them, and you can fix them by hand. When the chat searches the memory, it gets the pages found plus the summary of the linked ones : more context with few words. It also goes one step further, only along strong links: if "Studio Rossi" has "Marco Rossi" as contact, and his page says "- sede: Torino ", it reaches Torino too. It searches the aliases too: asking about "UDM" finds the page "Dream Machine", and a UDM leads to that page. The chat writes them when you ask "make a page about…", and from sources below . Safe writes : if you edit a page by hand while the agent works on it, its write is refused; it must read it again and start from your version. To read: teaching with files Put articles, notes, meeting transcripts, saved mails .md , .txt , .html , .eml , .csv , .json … in the da-leggere folder, or drag them onto the Memory window . Then: the agent reads each file; writes or updates the right pages, with the file's name in fonte: and the links; moves the file to fonti/ , untouched . It happens in the evening with the Memory digest or right away with Read now . Files that aren't text PDF, Word are passed with their path: Claude Code can open them. The check EasyIsland finds by itself: similar notes or notes older than six months, links to pages that don't exist, pages that are isolated, old or about the same subject. The agent adds the contradictions it notices and proposes the fixes in the island, one per line, with Do all / None or write which ones . It applies only the approved ones and never deletes : at most it moves a note to archivio.md or a page to archivio/pagine . It runs on Sunday evening with the digest, if there's something to fix, or right away with Check . The evening digest Settings → Flows → Memory digest : every evening at 22:30 the agent rereads the day's diary and proposes at most 5 things to remember it saves only those you approve ; reads the files in da-leggere ; on Sundays runs the check. If there's nothing to do it doesn't run and costs nothing. Memory engine In Settings → Chat and AI engines → Memory → Memory engine you can pick an engine, a free one too, that links the memory by writing it into the files: it creates a page for every subject that comes back in several notes a customer, a project, a person , with references to the notes, adds relations between pages "customer of", "works with"… and keeps every page's summary up to date, with its other names. It works by itself after the evening digest and when you press Link with AI in the map. It only adds: it never deletes or rewrites your notes. With a cloud engine the notes are sent to that service; with Ollama or LM Studio they stay on the PC. With None the map links the items by itself, from the words in common. The Memory window The button with three nodes at the top of the island or Settings → Chat and AI engines → Memory → Map opens a window of its own with the memory drawn four ways. A note links to the pages it talks about even without their full title, from the words in common and to similar notes; archived notes tied to nothing do not crowd the graph. Graph ! Click a star: its links light up, with sparks running along them, and on the right you see its text and the list of links. 3D graph The same graph in space, like a globe of stars. Drag to turn it it keeps spinning a little when you let go , wheel to come closer, double click to see everything. Far stars are fainter; click one and the globe turns to bring it in front of you. Mind map ! The mind map ../media/memoria-mappa.png One subject in the middle and what grows from it, up to three rings: each branch has its colour and grows from the centre. Click a branch to bring it to the middle. Concept map ! To read n : opens the folder; Read now and Check start the tasks right away. Drag files onto the window: they go to da-leggere . Remember… : a new note. h: One engine per task, and helper engines
x: Tasks A task is a goal you hand to EasyIsland and that it carries forward on its own , even while you do something else: it writes a plan, carries it out with the tools, asks you what only you know and finally gives you the result. Examples: "check tickets open for more than 3 days and prepare a summary", "every Monday at 8 give me the state of the Notion deadlines", "find three NAS suppliers and compare prices". Creating one In the chat : /compito … , or ask "do it as a task", "every day at 9…": the chat proposes the task and you create it with Allow. Settings → Flows → New task : title, goal, when, engine. From Telegram : /compito … . From an automation : the "Task" step. From a custom integration : a button of type "task". When Choice Example --- --- Now Starts as soon as there's room in the queue Once, at a time 24/10 at 15:00 Every day at 9:00 On weekdays at 8:30 Every week Monday at 8:00 Every N minutes every 60 minutes at least 15 How it works It writes the plan a few concrete steps and marks each step done. It uses EasyIsland's tools 10-ai-tools.md and the engine's, with the usual Allow / Deny for anything that changes something. If it needs a decision or a piece of information, it asks you a question : a card in the island with options and a free answer, and also on Telegram if linked. The first answer wins. It closes with the result , short and useful. If it was a check with nothing to say, it closes quietly . If the procedure could be useful again, it proposes saving it as a skill . It doesn't send emails, delete or approve anything by itself: it prepares drafts and leaves the last click to you. In the island each task is a session of the Tasks agent in the Agents tab, with plan, steps, questions and permissions like Claude Code. One task at a time; the others wait in the queue. States and commands Waiting for its time, Queued, Working, Waiting for an answer, Paused, Done, Failed, Stopped. From Settings and the island you can run now , pause , resume , stop , answer , delete and read the task's log a .md file . Limits Settings → Flows : maximum turns and minutes per run 12 turns and 30 minutes by default , then the task pauses and tells you. One engine per task, and helper engines Each task can have its own engine and model for example free opencode for checks, Claude for writing . You can give it helper engines : the leading engine can hand one of them part of the work a search, a review, a draft and get the result back, like agents do with sub-agents. On Telegram With Telegram linked you get a message when a task finishes, fails, pauses or waits for an answer. Answer with the buttons or with /rispondi … . Tasks' permissions arrive there too never auto-approved, not even with "Automatic" . Heartbeat A periodic check : every N minutes the agent looks at the things you wrote in BATTITO.md and tells you only if there's something . Settings → Flows → Heartbeat : choose how often and open the list with What to keep an eye on… . With an empty list it doesn't run and costs nothing. Memory digest Every evening at 22:30 it rereads the day, proposes what to remember, learns from the files in da-leggere and on Sundays checks the memory. Turn it on in Settings → Flows ; details in Memory 11-memory.md the-evening-digest . Skills A skill is a procedure of yours written in a .md file: how you make a quote, how you close a ticket, how you prepare the monthly report. The AI reads it only when needed , so you can have many at no cost. Where : %APPDATA%\EasyIsland\abilita\ . In Settings → Flows → Skills you create, edit, delete them and open the folder. The header keys are in Italian nome , descrizione , motore , strumenti . How they're used : the chat and tasks see the list name and description and read the right one when needed. Each skill is also a command : /ticket-closing in the chat and on Telegram. Engine : a skill can state the preferred engine; a task uses it by delegating that step. They improve by themselves : at the end of a task the agent may propose saving the procedure as a new skill with Allow / Deny .

Linking the bot On Telegram write to @BotFather , /newbot , and copy the token . Settings → Integrations → Telegram : paste the token it goes into the Credential Manager . EasyIsland reads Telegram with long polling: no open port, no server in between, only api.telegram.org . You can write with the PC off too: messages wait on Telegram and EasyIsland handles them in order as soon as it's back, telling you it's doing so. Handy for a "remember that…" while you're out. Telegram keeps them about 24 hours : older ones are lost. The chat on Telegram A conversation of its own , separate from the island's, with engine and model chosen from there. The answer arrives as it's written, with ⏹ Stop . Remote access A temporary connection to a client's PC, Windows or Linux, for the chat to work on it. Connecting In the Remote access tab: WinRM or SSH , address, port, user, password; for WinRM also "HTTPS 5986 " and "Add to TrustedHosts". A step-by-step guide explains how to prepare the client's PC. Start connection tests the connection. The password stays only in EasyIsland's memory while the connection is open; the field is cleared right away. Nothing is saved. WinRM uses Windows PowerShell; SSH Windows' ssh.exe OpenSSH . With the chat With a connection open, 🔌 and the PC's name appear in the chat header also Link to the chat in the tab . From there the chat runs commands on the client's PC , one at a time PowerShell on Windows, sh on Linux , each with Allow / Deny and the full command on the card. Examples: "why won't the spooler start?", "how much space is on the disks?", "check the latest errors in the event log". Closing Close connection : the chat is unlinked, the password forgotten, the address removed from TrustedHosts with Windows' confirmation , WinRM turned off again if it was. Common errors TrustedHosts, access denied, PC not answering, connection refused, old OpenSSH become clear messages saying what to do. Remote Desktop Manager If you use Devolutions' Remote Desktop Manager , the integration brings it into the island. RDM stays the program that connects : EasyIsland finds the connection and asks RDM to open, edit or search it. It never reads a password. Connection list from the official Devolutions.PowerShell module needs PowerShell 7.2 or later : the same data source as RDM, Devolutions Server and Hub with the user's vaults too. It's kept encrypted on the PC for offline use and refreshed with Sync . Search by name, folder or host, from the tab and the island's top field; a click opens the session in RDM. Without the module : search opens inside RDM, and you can connect to an address without saving it RDP or SSH . In Settings you see the state of RDM, PowerShell 7 and the module, with the commands to copy to install them EasyIsland never runs them .

Creating one Write in the chat what you need, for example: "create an integration for quotes, with client, product rows with quantity and price, 22 % VAT and total, that makes the PDF"; "I want an interventions log with client, date, hours, type and notes, and the month's total hours"; "make me a dashboard that reads my servers' status from the Uptime Kuma API every 10 minutes and alerts me if one is down"; "a button that sends the form to my n8n webhook". The chat proposes useful fields, formulas and actions, asks what isn't clear and shows you the preview of the description with Allow / Deny . Confirming, the integration appears in the island's menu with its icon. To change it just ask "add a discount field", "make the total bold" : same preview, same confirmation. Important: a custom integration is a description , never code: its actions are a fixed, safe list. ! A custom integration ../media/custom.png What it can have Fields Text, long text, number, amount , date, checkbox, choice and multiple choice, email, phone, link, file from the Tray , table of rows with computed columns too , computed a formula , automatic numbering e.g. N-2026-0001 , link to another integration e.g. the quote picking a client from the "Clients" records . Shown only if : a field visible only when a formula is true e.g. "IBAN" only if payment = Bank transfer . Total in the list : summed or counted in the records list. Formulas A simple language, in Italian or English: + - / % , comparisons, and / or / not , if condition; yes; no , sum quantity price over rows, avg , count , round , min , max , dates today , days from; to , adddays date; 30 , year, month , text upper , concat , contains , len . Never code executed. Document template A Markdown document with {{fields}} , repeated rows {{ rows}} … {{/rows}} and the date. Document produces it as printable HTML from there "Print → PDF" or Markdown, in the Tray. Actions the buttons Action What it does --- --- Save Saves the record list with search, open, duplicate, delete Document The filled template, in the Tray Copy The text to the clipboard Ask the AI A question to the chat with the fields Fill with AI Paste a mail or a text and the AI fills the fields Link Opens an address with the fields Quick action Runs one of your actions Notion Adds the record to a database Export CSV All records, for Excel Call a service GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to one of your services' API, with the fields in the body; the response can fill fields and show in a message Task Starts a task 12-tasks.md with the fields in the goal Notice A notice in the island Sequence Several actions in a row e.g. save, then call the service, then make the document Data sources: dashboards A source reads a service every N minutes or when you open the tab and shows values and lists . An alert is a formula on each item: when true, the island alerts you, once per item, and the first line goes to the Overview. An integration can also be just a dashboard , with no form. ! A dashboard ../media/custom-dati.png Keys Services' keys and tokens are written as {{secret:name}} and entered in Settings → Integrations → Made by you : they go into the Credential Manager, only EasyIsland reads them at call time and neither the island nor the chat ever sees them . From the chat and tasks The chat and tasks can read records , add them with Allow / Deny , read sources and call the actions of your integrations: "how many quotes did I make in October?", "log a 2-hour intervention for Rossi", "check the servers and tell me if anything's wrong". Managing them Settings → Integrations → Made by you : show or hide in the menu, edit the JSON description, enter keys, delete. Files live in %APPDATA%\EasyIsland\integrazioni description and records, readable . Limits, on purpose No code : an action does only what its kind provides. Calls go only to the services written in the description you approved. No data "pushed" by services incoming webhooks , because that would need an open port on the PC: a source read every N minutes is used instead. It works with the PC on.

What it never does Send an email or approve a permission without your click. Only exception: Telegram's "Automatic" turned on by you, which still asks about deletions. Run arbitrary commands on this PC from the AI's tools: only your quick actions, or terminal mode with a permission for each command. Delete : tools don't delete, except a Notion row to its trash after your yes in the chat; the working folder uses the Windows Recycle Bin; the memory archives and never deletes. Overwrite agents' configurations: first a dated backup, the diff and your confirmation. Block an agent : if EasyIsland doesn't answer, the agent carries on by itself. Accept everything without checks: the mode that skips every permission doesn't exist. Secrets API keys, tokens, passwords and secret links live in the Windows Credential Manager , never on disk, never in the interface, never in git, never in backups. The interface can only ask whether a key exists. Remote access passwords stay only in memory while the connection is open. The Notion and RDM maps on disk are encrypted with Windows data protection DPAPI . Network No telemetry. Requests only go: to the services you configure AI engines, integrations, widgets, custom integrations to the hosts written in their description ; to GitHub for the update check , which can be turned off in Settings → General. Updates install only after a click , with the signature verified . No port is opened on the PC Telegram uses long polling .
